preconditions.name: null_zero_anchor_reproduces_778c_railed_signature
preconditions.description: READINESS ANCHOR (both-rails predicate; CORRECTED in V3-EXQ-778h). ARM_NULL_ZERO IS the V3-EXQ-778c rem condition on the same seeds and the same RNG stream, so it must reproduce 778c's railed signature. Measured as the FRACTION of seeds railed -- the SAME railed/de-railed statistic the load-bearing criterion routes on, asserted on the known-degenerate positive control. A seed counts as railed if it hit EITHER rail: (a) SATURATION (reference clamped across the grid -> constant series -> zero slope) or (b) POSITIVITY-FLOOR COLLAPSE (reference touched the 1e-3 floor and the fit went off-scale, |ratio| >= 100.0). V3-EXQ-778d's predicate tested rail (a) ONLY, so the 3/8 floor-collapsed seeds (ratios 1801-9143) were scored HEALTHY and the anchor could reach at most 5/8 = 0.625 against a 0.75 gate -- unmeetable by construction, and the sole cause of that run's degeneracy flag on the load-bearing criterion. A reachability guard now asserts at setup that the frozen reference clears this gate under the shipped predicate. If the anchor does not reproduce, something other than the null-mode differs from 778c and the contrast is uninterpretable -> requeue, never a verdict about the clamp.
preconditions.control: ARM_NULL_ZERO == the V3-EXQ-778c null (known-degenerate positive control)
